title: Great bike rental option.
text: This was a great place to rent bikes for the day. They were so friendly and helpful, and the prices were reasonable. We enjoyed seeing Barcelona on the bikes, at our own pace.
author: Kristin_H

title: Excellent.
text: Excellent service, the girls were very nice and helped us a lot, the bikes work perfectly, and we had a great time.
author: 235elaa

title: Cycling on your own.
text: Super simple and straightforward.  The young man who had handed us the bikes also came from our homeland.
author: Bernd_D

title: Great bikes, excellent service!
text: During our summer holidays in Barcelona we always rent bicycles, even this year. What was new was that we now went to another bike rental company for the first time in years. To A-bike. And that went down very well. Fine e-bikes with good support that took us effortlessly to Tibidabo and Montjuic. Longer bike rides along the coast towards Premia de Mar were also no problem.  We rented the bikes for 7 days, got a nice proposal from the manager and ended up enjoying it for 9 days. title: Bike hire in Barcelona
text:
Great bike hire
Took the bikes for 2 hours went all the way down the beach and back at a leisurely pace
Staff were friendly and helpful and the bikes are comfortable. Would recommend
author: 326craigm

title: Excellent bikes, friendly staff and great location
text: Very friendly staff (Agne, Alex, Wassim, Kene all helped today) and great location close to La Rambla. Perfect location to start a cycle from Columbus monument all the way along the coast. Fantastic way to see Barcelona. Bikes were good quality. Highly recommend!
author: jmsua

title: The a-bike bike is an excellent choice
text: Bike tour around Barcelona. Given the season I recommend 3 hours. Located in an easy to reach location within easy reach of Raval, Ramblers, the port and the Gothic Quarter. Metro stop 50 m away. Bikes in order and very kind, friendly and helpful staff. Good experience.
author: msulmoni

title: Easy convenient way to get out of the city.
text: Renting a bicycle is the best way to access the beaches out of the city itself. We loved the easy cycle route with cycle lanes that took us out of the city along the coastal promenade to the quieter beaches.
author: Charlotte_N
